claim: §8.1 immediate fix — a release that cannot break launch or the day rollover: staged rollout with crash-rate gating (201 reviews blame a specific update; single days with 49 reviews — a halted rollout would have contained 2016-11, 2017-10 and 2021-08-20); make 'start new day' (cron) idempotent and visible and never let a failed rollover block ticking tasks (BUG_RESET 93); fix tap targets that register on the wrong task and widget refresh (BUG_WIDGET 22).

§8.2 immediate fix — sign-up and login that never dead-ends: BUG_SIGNUP 139 (1.55★) and BUG_ACCOUNT 85 — the onboarding Finish button, Google sign-in returning to the same screen, prefilled usernames that cannot be changed; an offline-first first run so a server error does not stop someone creating their first task — also serves mainland China (NEG_CHINA_NET 16) and NEG_OFFLINE 55.

§8.3 immediate fix — ship the translations volunteers already made: release finished locales in the iOS build as soon as they reach parity on web and Android, fix the language setting that reverts to English; publish a translation call for Turkish and Korean inside those storefronts — reviewers there are offering to help and ask with 176 votes on Turkish-store language reviews.

§8.4 immediate fix — purchases that credit and cancellations that work: restore/credit checks for subscription benefits and gems (BUG_IAP 9), a visible cancel path and clear App Store subscription management (MON_CANCEL_HARD 4), a preview of paid backgrounds.
